descriptor: Weekly meal kits with pre-measured ingredients

voice.summary: A friend who has already done the shopping: relaxed, cheerful and a bit wry about washing-up. Short sentences, clear prices and a dependable promise of dinner.
dos: State times, prices and discounts plainly
Use ingredient and kitchen words, not wellness jargon
Mention flexibility, such as skip a week or cancel any time
donts: Fine print hidden below the fold

taglines: A box that cooks with you
Skip a week, never skip dinner
boilerplate: Pantry Post delivers weekly recipe boxes of fresh, pre-measured ingredients with meals ready in 30 minutes or less, with no commitment to keep ordering.

microcopy.error: We couldn't update your box. Try again
microcopy.empty: Your box is empty. Pick a meal

logo.note: A shopping bag stands for a box that arrives at the door with dinner inside.
